balls.text: comes round the wicket and believe it or not he's beaten on the drive!
pushes it down to long-on and gives Harbhajan the strike
pushes it down to long-on
clears his front leg and slams him straight down the ground, long-off can't cut it off
bang! He stays back and slaps it wide of mid-off and the ball races to the wide long-off boundary
this man's on fire! Friendly full toss and he clubs it over midwicket
another Beamer, this time Harbhajan pulls him down to fine leg and Jaskaran has been penalised, he's out of the attack
the beamer and Jaskaran offers his apologies, Harbhajan just gets his face out of the way
streaky! He goes for a wild swing and gets an inside edge which sneaks past his stumps and beats short fine leg
he's unstoppable! Pitched up on the pads and he effortless flicks it in the air wide of midwicket
fires it outside off and he fails to dig it out
Harbhajan's having a party! Roach fires it on the pads and Harbhajan shovels kit high over deep square leg
stays at the crease and slaps a good length ball over extra cover, bisects two fielders
opens the face of the bat and runs it down to short third man
Harbhajan goes straight over the bowler's head this time, bends his knee and times the scoop really well, the ball just drops short of the boundary
take cover! Tossed up on middle and leg and Harbhajan swings it with ease over wide long-on, what timing!
slower ball again and tucked to deep midwicket, sharp fielding limits that to a single
slower ball and McLaren pulls and the ball hits his pads
he lives dangerously again, chips it in the air but just short of long-on
fired on the pads but he fails to tuck it away
chipped in the air but the ball drops in the vacant midwicket region

RP has delivered the big blow! He bowls the slower bouncer, Sachin comes down the pitch and tries to power it over the on side, he fetches the ball from wide outside off and manages a thick edge to Gilchrist, no doubt about that one
good improvisation, RP bowls it short on seeing sachin come down the track, he quickly adjusts after giving himself room and carves it over short third man
squeezes out a yorker and beats the bowler
poor effort from Jaskaran, McLaren tucks it to long leg and Jaskaran appears to have it covered but tries to stop it one handed, beats him

gets across his stumps and on his knee, paddles a low full toss to fine leg and Roach nearly over runs the ball, picks it up one handed and Sachin completes the second to get to his fifty, a hardworking fifty
good shot! He gets on his knee and sweeps him high over square leg
clips it to the on side
short and pulled to deep midwicket, Mishtra does well to slide and cut it off, relays it to OJha
chips it stylishly on one leg over midwicket, Rao's there to cut  it off
tucked to the on side and he refuses the single
short and drifting on the body, the ball rolls to the on side
tucks him up for room and Sachin pushes it  back to the bowler
good response from McLaren as he pulls a short one and Gibbs slides at deep square leg and cuts it off
short and tucked back to the bowler
he's going to make a few dents on the pitch, another steep delivery and McLaren can only watch that sail to the keeper
bangs it on the pitch again and he doesn't offer a shot
thuds it on the pitch and the ball fizzes past him
full on the off stump and driven down to Rao at deep cover
slower ball on the pads and tucked to fine leg
chipped in the air and the ball drops short of long-on
welcomes him with a short one on the body, manages to fend it off
full on the stumps and tucked down to long-on

Pollard follows the procession! Short of a length, Pollard tries to deposit that over the on side but ends up hitting it in the other direction,the top edge swirls towards third man and Suman runs forward and takes it on the fall, he nearly lost sight of the ball
tossed up on leg and Sachin gets a leading edge to the off side
rocks back and cuts to deep extra cover
keeps it straight and on the stumps, Pollard defends again, Ojha's tying them down
gets forward and steers it to the off side
quicker through the air and defended to the off side
soft one! Sathish gets on his knee and tries to paddle scoop Ojha down to fine leg, the ball lobs up and offers Suman the easiest of catches at short fine leg
knocks it down to short third man for a single
tries to run it down to third man, he actually hits it off the face of the bat and Gilchrist fails to catch it, the umpires signals byes though
Symonds gives him width, Tendulkar gets beside the line and scoops it in the air wide of the backward point region
drops it down the pitch with soft hands
clips it to short midwicket with soft hands and gives sachin the strike
squeezes it out to cover
full on the off stump and driven back to the bowler
easy for Gilchrist, Rayudu gives him the charge and goes for the loft over long-on, beaten in flight, Gilly whips off the bails, the third umpire takes a look but Rayudu knew he was gone
full on the pads and he tucks it down to deep square leg
lovely deft touch, gets on his knee, picks it from outside leg and gently paddles it wide of Jaskaran at short fine leg
drops it wide of the silly point region and sets off, Tendulkar was off the blocks very quickly
mistimes the drive to the on side but beats the bowler
Rayudu moves right across his stumps to paddle it somewhere on the on side but misses, harsh call by the umpire if u ask me
angles it across the right-hander and he opens the face and dabs it down to third man who's square
good ball, tucks him up for room and he softly pushes it down the pitch
shuffles across to cover his stumps and pushes it through the line to long-on
gently eased away towards midwicket and Ojha has a shy at the bowler's end but Sachin's too quick for him
moves right across his stumps and tucks it towards short square leg
tucks it in front of deep square leg and thinks of a second run
tucks it to the on side for a single
appeal! Pitches outside leg from over the wicket and hits his front pad in front of he off stump, can't give that out
full on the off stump and driven down to long-off
continues over the wicket, rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover
tucked to the on side
poor shot after that boundary! RP swings it away from the left-hander and Tiwary drives away from the  body and Gilchrist takes the edge, double strike there for RP
poor delivery and put away, bounce and width outside off to free his arms, reaches out and slashes it over backward point
bouncer to wake him up, fizzes past his body, sways back to evade it
Symonds didn't have to move, Bravo lofts a pitched up delivery outside off and scoops it straight down Symonds' throat at long-off
well bowled, on the stumps and Bravo punches it back to the bowler
gives him width andSachin bends his knee slightly and upper cuts it down to third man
hit hard but straight to square leg
gets forward and under the bounce and scoops it hard over mid-off, Roach sprints across to his left from long-off but he can't cut it off, power from Bravo
gets forward and tucks it just wide of midwicket
gets forward and drives back to the bowler
slower ball but too wide outside off, doesn't offer a shot
pushes it towards mid-on for a single
take that! Bravo leans into a full away swinging delivery and drives very firmly inside out past cover, that raced to the fence before you could blink
classic Sachin! He moves across his stumps and nonchalantly flicks it across  the line and picks the big gap at midwicket, this man's in imperious touch
bangs it in short, Sachin swivels, gets on top of the bounce and pulls him over square leg, big gap and he picks it
goes for the loft over long-on but mistimes the shot and the ball drops just wide of Jaskaran at mid-on
punches it back to the bowler, RP turns back and sees Tendulkar out of his creasem tries to palm the ball towards the stumps but the batsman's home
tucks him up for room and Bravo defends with soft hands and tells his partner to wait
comes down the pitch and pushes it in front of Symonds at mid-off and sets off
rocks back to cut but misses it
beats him with a ripper that turns and bounces, continues from over the wicket
forces it to the on side and deep square leg's there to cut it off
pushed back to the bowler
now he chips down the track, takes it on the full and forces it past the bowler, lot of power behind both shots
flighted on leg from over the wicket, Bravo stays at the crease and whams it high over wide long-on, that went miles in the air
walks down the pitch and squirts it out straight to Venugopal Rao at midwicket
slower ball and it's a full toss which he fails to put away, goes straight to extra cover
Free Hit: Jaskaran loses control again and sprays the leg cutter down the leg side, another wide called
Free Hit: Jaskaran loses complete control of it and sprays it really wide outside off, the ball nearly goes towards slip and it's another no ball
he oversteps, gets forward and times the push well, beats cover and there's protection in the deep
angles it across the right hander and he opens the face and places it down to third man
on the toes and Dhawan's got to go! Nice inswinging yorker there, jams his toes on his right foot as he tries to squeeze it out, in front of leg and middle, easy decision there
driven on the up just wide of short extra cover
he pitched it up on off and middle and Tendulkar gets under the bounce and plays slightly across the line, places it in the big gap at midwicket
short of a length and he fends it off with soft hands
oh well played! He bowls it full and in the slot for Dhawan to get on the front foot to piece the gap between cover and backward point
145 kph, steep delivery that fizzes past Dhawan's body, great bounce and carry
quick and on the blockhole outside off, he squirts it straight to point
short and directly aimed at the body, Dhawan barely had time to react, he managed to fend it off his chest
full and driven straight to short extra cover, good stop by the fielder
opens the face and dabs it to third man
in the air and just beats Gibbs, comes forward and scoops it just wide of Gibbs at short cover who flings himself to his right
he's underway now, full on the off stump,he maintains a still head and merely pushes it through the line, beats mid-off and cover and the ball races away
solid contact with the bat this time but he pushes it straight to mid-on off the front foot
Tendulkar goes for the booming off drive but he's beaten all ends up, odd that he missed that
127.4 kph, even Jaskaran aims for the yorker, hits his pads and rolls away to the on side
squirts out a yorker on  the leg stump, 141.4 kph there
fires it on the pads and he tries to flick it away, there's a stifled appeal for lbw but down the leg side
full on the off stump and squired to point
144.9 kph, full and wide outside off and Dhawan can't resist another slash, hits the toe of the bat and flies past backward point and beats third man
he bowls it wide outside off and Dhawan lashes at it, wide called
139 kph, he fires it full on the off stump and Dhawan pushes it to point
and Roach tries to fire a yorker but it's a high full toss down the leg side, very close to the thigh and not called a wide
timber and out! Malinga fires an off stump yorker and it's too quick for RP to dig it out, swings in late and pegs the off stump back
makes room and tries to swing, he misses the ball completely
takes his eyes off a fast bouncer and the ball hits his forearm and rolls away

the middle stump is flattened! Roach exposes all three stumps and tries to launch that anywhere, swing and a miss and the middle stump lands a couple of yards back and takes the stump mic wire with it
fires it on a good length and he tucks it to fine leg
quick yorker and Rohit has to go, he makes a bit of room and the ball hits the bottom of the bat and deflects to the base of the off stump, the bails are down
drops it in front of cover to quickly get off the strike
Roach looks clueless, all he can do is push it back to the bowler again
high full toss and Roach can only push it back to Zaheer
another yorker and he digs it out on the full and Sathish does really well at deep midwicket to cut it off
nice inswinging yorker, he can only dig it out back to the bowler
full on the pads and clipped to fine leg
superb yorker, Rohit just manages to squirt it out with his bat and the ball lobs over the stumps, Malinga appeals thinking it clipped his boot
clips it away down to fine leg
well played a well fielded, just opens the face to run it wide of the keeper, McLaren dives at third man to save 2 runs
no turn this time, he opens the face and dabs it to short third man
turn and bounce, Roach shuffles and gently tickles it past the keeper, good attempt by sachin to try and cut it off
squirts out a yorker to the off side
Harbhajan's having a dream night! Jaskaran sashays down the track hoping to deposit it over deep midwicket but finds substitute Duminy
drives a low full toss to Malinga at deep cover
turns it down to square leg
just over the rope! Rohit stays at the crease and nonchalantly lofts him high over the off side, the fielder at deep cover dives near the rope but the ball just beats him
tucks i to deep midwicket and calls for two straightaway, his partner cooperates
delicately done, uses the pace on the ball to cheekily paddle it high over short fine leg, just drops short of the rope
short arm pull to Malinga at short fine leg, Jaskaran is sent back and the throw is wide at his end
Rao holes out! He bends his knee and tries to slog him over deep midwicket, doesn't get the distance and McLaren takes it easily
another boundary to ease the pressure a bit, makes a bit of room to a full toss and clubs it past the bowler and the umpire
nice shot! He makes room to a full delivery on the off stump and digs it out to deep cover, the timing was top class
stays back and tucks it to the on side for a single
now it's a low full toss which he fails to put away, mid-off collects it
tries to cut but he ends up chopping it towards the keeper
half volley on the pads but he fails to put it away
gets on the front foot this time and places it to sweeper cover again
lots of width outside off and he slaps it to sweeper cover
squirts it to the off side for a single
makes a lot of room but ends up steering it down to point
turns it to deep midwicket for a couple
tucks it to short midwicket
well done, gets off the mark with a gentle dab down to third man, opens the face and beats the fielder within the circle

full toss lobbed back to the bowler! Oh boy Suman will be kicking himself, he shaped to scoop that over the on side, a pumped up Harbhajan had some choice words for the batsman after taking the catch, control yourself Bhajji, there's no need to get so mad!
paddles it to short fine leg
dabs it to short third man
take that! Effortless stuff, stays at the crease and punches on the up it dead straight over the bowler's head, one for the album
tucks it in the air down to long leg for a couple
tries to hook but the ball hits his helmet and drops to the off side, Suman doesn't know where it's gone, attempts a run and the throw to the bowler's end is wide
flat bats it straight to Binny at mid-off, Suman's eyeing a big hit somewhere
stays back and punches it straight to mid-on
slaps it to Tiwary at sweeper cover
drives wide of long-off and shouts 'two' immediately, Sathish mops up but limits it to the single, Harbhajan is peeved that the throw wasn't to his own end
loses control and fires it wide really down the leg side
pushed down to long-on for a single
fires it on the pads and he squirts it down to deep square leg
shuffles and clips it with the turn down to long leg
down the leg side, doesn't offer a shot
full on the pads and pushed to long-on
slower bouncer outside off, he swats it to extra cover
bowls the bouncer this time, he safely ducks under it
slower ball, pushes it back to the bowler
tucks it to deep square leg
Confusion! He cuts to point and there's hesitation in the calling, Rohit survives as the throw at the bowler's end is wide,a direct hit would have sent him back
opens the face and dabs it down to third man
crisply timed off the front foot but straight to mid-off
clean hit! Pitched up outside off and he stays at the crease and takes him downtown with a free swing of the arms, over long-off
pushed just wide of cover and Tiwary fires it to the keeper, Rohit is sent back, dives in desperation and Rayudu's flick misses the stumps, a direct hit would have sent him back

Deccan are all over the place now! Malinga gives him some room to work with and bangs it in short of a length, Symonds can't resist a slash and ends up hitting it flat to Bravo at third man, the ball dipped on Bravo but he managed to take it easily
hits the deck hard and he lets the bouncer sail over his head
doesn't give him width again, has to settle for a steer to backward point
steers it towards cover point and tells his partner to wait
tucks him up for room, he pushes it down the pitch
the loft doesn't come off well, Malinga bowls the slower ball, Mishra stays at the crease and tries to loft over long-off but he ends up splicing it to McLaren at mid-off
traps him on the pads and it appeared to be hitting him in front of middle, may have just gone over the stumps, Malinga appealed but the others weren't interested
gets off the mark with a glide past the diving backward point fielder

Gibbs stands his ground thinking that was a waist-high no ball, he slashes a full toss straight to Pollard at cover point, Gibbs hangs around and glances at the square leg umpire, replays show that it was below the waist, he has to go
goes the other way this time! He gets under the bounce to a pitched up delivery and scoops it over long-off
signature Gibbs! Good length on middle and reads the length so early, rides the bounce and flat bats it over long-on
good length on leg and he tucks it to the on side
makes room to squirt it out but he misses
another bouncer this time over the batsman's head, harsh call for a wide and sachin's not happy
nice bouncer, fizzes past the batsman as he tries to upper cut it
pushes it to the off side for a single
bashes it past the bowler but Malinga gets a hand to it at mid-off
defends with soft hands down the pitch
lovely shot! Comes down the track, he comes to the pitch of the ball and lofts high and far over wide long-on
pitched up outside off, he reaches forward, gets under the bounce and scoops him over extra cover
tucks it to square leg, he can't pinch a single there
pushed to the on side for a single
full on the off stump and he mistimes the drive to mid-off
shuffles and tucks it across the line to fine leg
no slip, Mishra goes for a booming off drive but make contact with the toe of the bat, the ball races wide of the keeper and third man's too square
poor delivery, down the leg side and Mishra runs it down to fine leg off his pads
drives on the up and the ball is scooped down to third man, one bounce to Bravo
tucks it straight to Harbhajan at midwicket and tells his partner to wait
turns the face of the bat and tucks it down to fine leg
fends it to the off side
poor stuff by McLaren, Gibbs sweeps with all his power and the ball scorches to deep square leg, McLaren gets behind the ball but it slips through the gate
add some bounce to that turn! He shoulders arms and the ball beats Rayudu's gloves and rolls sway
turn this time, hits the bat and pad
no turn, he opens the face and dabs it wide of short third man

Sachin take a bow! Harbhajan fires it flat from round the wicket, Gilchrist tries to cut it to third man and gets an outside edge, Sachin takes it one handed low at first slip, super reflexes and his strategy has worked
Harbhajan opens the bowling, pushes it to the on side
